questions.stem: A company has many written safety programs, but responsibilities conflict, objectives are not measured, and corrective actions are not tracked across departments. What distinguishes the needed management-system approach?

Assign every safety responsibility to the EHS department alone

questions.stem: At a management-system gap assessment, a supervisor proposes: "Wait for each similar guard to fail before entering a new action". The underlying case is: A corrective action closes one damaged guard, but similar machines use the same weak mounting design. What management-system response is best? Limit correction to the machine involved because the finding was local
Wait for each similar guard to fail before entering a new action
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: Management systems seek systemic learning. Similar exposure should be evaluated proactively rather than treating repeated design weaknesses as isolated events.
